title: Symbols, Linked Assets & Component Systems
subtitle: Symbol Creation, Detached Synchronization, Asset Studio & Vector UI Kits
description: Master scalable design systems and reusable component architecture in Affinity Designer: create multi-instance symbols, master the critical Sync toggle for local overrides versus global propagation, organize enterprise asset libraries in the Assets Studio, and distribute .afassets packages across design and production teams.
prerequisites: D01: Designer Interface, Personas & Canvas Setup
D05: Layer Organization, Masks & Clipping Paths
learningOutcomes: Create and manage linked vector symbols using the Symbols Studio.
Master the Sync button (Synchronize ON/OFF) to execute safe local instance overrides without severing master links.
Organize multi-tier component libraries inside the Assets Studio using Categories and Subcategories.
Export, import, and distribute portable .afassets bundles across enterprise design systems.
Build a production-ready vector UI component kit featuring scalable variants, states, and nested symbols.

capstoneProject.title: Enterprise Analytics Dashboard Component System
capstoneProject.description: Construct an end-to-end vector design system in Affinity Designer comprising synchronized button states, modular metric cards, and navigation bars with detached local overrides archived into an .afassets library.
evaluationCriteria: Master symbols created with visible orange link indicators in Layers Studio.
Local text overrides applied successfully with Sync OFF.
Global styling modifications propagated to all instances with Sync ON.
Reusable UI components archived into structured Assets Studio subcategories.
